title: 第19章 酆都鬼帝四方鬼王第20章 天人境强者鬼帝玉佩
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
一念至此，陆尘嘿嘿直笑的逼近小狐狸。
嘤嘤嘤……
小狐狸看着陆尘邪恶的表情，感觉到一些不对劲，有些畏惧的嘤嘤嘤叫。
“嘿嘿嘿，拿来吧你！”
陆尘一个跨步，直接一把抱住了小狐狸，
随后不顾小狐狸的挣扎，陆尘的咸猪手在小狐狸的身上摸来摸去，
嘤嘤嘤……
“别说，还挺好rua，毛茸茸，丝滑无比。”
陆尘一边摸一边喃喃自语。
而此刻，小狐狸直接生无可恋了，原本银白色的毛发此刻彻底变成了粉红色。
【恭喜你，完成逆袭任务，把高处不胜寒冷淡无比的一代妖帝拥抱在怀里并且狠狠的撸了一把。】
【完成逆袭任务，任务奖励：魔神观想图！】
【注意：魔神观想图存在于虚无之中，只需要宿主心念一动，便能把魔神观想图给召唤出来。】
这个时候，陆尘眼前再次出现半透明的面板。
透明面板上缓缓浮现出文字。
“还真是！”
看到面板上的文字，陆尘喃喃自语。
谁能想到，现在自己怀里近乎是任人宰割的小狐狸，在未来竟然是一代妖帝，神秘妖族圣地的圣女。
“走了，回去。”
把小狐狸放了下来，陆尘扭头看向后方正在兴冲冲抓鱼的张言信开口。

“好嘞老大。”
张言信听到此言，兴冲冲的来到身旁。
“小狐狸，你身世非凡，想来不会出什么问题，拜拜，就此别过喽！”
陆尘对着地上的小狐狸挥了挥手，随后和张言信径直向城内走去，
只留下小狐狸站在原地，歪着脑袋看着陆尘的背影。
随后嘤嘤嘤的叫了一声，小狐狸快速跟在陆尘后方奔跑。
随后纵身一跃，直接跳到陆尘的肩膀上。
“嗯？小狐狸，你想跟着我啊！”
陆尘看到这一幕，脸上露出了诧异的神色。
不过思考了一会儿，脸上不由露出一丝笑意。
“既然你想跟着就跟过来吧。”
陆尘摸了摸小狐狸的脑袋开口。
“胖子，今天发生的一切，我希望你什么都没看到。记住了嘛！”
安疆侯府门口，陆尘笑眯眯的看着张言信开口。
而张言信看着陆尘笑眯眯的表情，却是从中看到了冰冷的杀意。
一念至此，张言信立马打了个哆嗦。
“老大你放心，我保证什么都没有看到，我叫张言信。我绝对言而有信。”
张言信重重开口。
听到此言，陆尘满意的点了点头，伸出手拍了拍张言信的肩膀，把一枚空间戒指递给了张言信。
空间戒指是刚才黑衣刺客的。

陆尘把他空间戒指里的东西全部转移到了自己的空间戒指。
剩下一个多余的小空间戒指用不上，在里面放了一枚回春丹，一枚破境丹给张言信做人情。
回到皇宫之内。陆尘走在皇宫蜿蜒崎岖的宫道上。
很快便回到了元秀殿。
content_en:
As soon as he thought about this, Lu Chen approached the little fox with a smile.
嘤嘤嘤……
The little fox looked at Lu Chen's evil expression and felt something was wrong, so he growled in fear.
"Hey hey hey, bring it to you!"
Lu Chen took a step forward and hugged the little fox.
Then, regardless of the little fox's struggle, Chase Lu's salty hands touched the little fox's body.
嘤嘤嘤……
"Don't tell me, it's pretty rua, fluffy and silky smooth."
Lu Chen murmured to himself while touching it.
But at this moment, the little fox was beyond love, and its originally silver-white hair turned completely pink.
[Congratulations, you have completed the counterattack mission, hugged the demon emperor who was so cold and indifferent from the heights, and gave him a hard hand. 】
[Complete the counterattack mission, mission reward: Demon God Visualization Picture! 】
[Note: The Demonic God’s Visualization Chart exists in nothingness. It only takes the host’s thoughts to summon the Demonic God’s Visualization Chart. 】
At this time, a translucent panel appeared in front of Chen Lu again.
Text slowly emerged on the transparent panel.
"It's true!"
Seeing the words on the panel, Lu Chen murmured to himself.
Who would have thought that the little fox in his arms who was almost at the mercy of others would turn out to be a demon emperor in the future and a saint of the mysterious demon clan's holy land.
"Let's go, go back."
After putting the little fox down, Lu Chen turned to look at Zhang Yanxin who was catching fish happily behind him and spoke.
"Okay, boss."
When Zhang Yanxin heard this, he came to his side excitedly.
"Little fox, you have an extraordinary life experience. I don't think there will be any problems. Goodbye, let's just say goodbye!"
Lu Chen waved to the little fox on the ground, and then walked straight into the city with Zhang Yanxin.
The little fox was left standing there, tilting his head and looking at Lu Chen's back.
Then he let out a cry, and the little fox quickly ran behind Lu Chen.
Then he jumped directly onto Lu Chen's shoulders.
"Huh? Little fox, you want to follow me!"
Seeing this scene, Lu Chen had a surprised look on his face.
But after thinking for a while, a smile couldn't help but appear on his face.
"If you want to follow, then come along."
Lu Chen touched the little fox's head and spoke.
"Fat man, I hope you didn't see anything about what happened today. Just remember it!"
At the door of the Anjiang Hou Mansion, Lu Chen looked at Zhang Yanxin with a smile and spoke.
But when Zhang Yanxin looked at Lu Chen's smiling expression, he saw cold murderous intent in it.
As soon as he thought of this, Zhang Yanxin immediately shuddered.
"Don't worry, boss. I promise I didn't see anything. My name is Zhang Yanxin. I will definitely keep my word."
Zhang Yanxin spoke seriously.
Hearing this, Lu Chen nodded with satisfaction, reached out and patted Zhang Yanxin on the shoulder, and handed a space ring to Zhang Yanxin.
The space ring belonged to the assassin in black just now.
Lu Chen transferred all the contents of his space ring to his own space ring.
There was an extra small space ring left that was not needed, so I put a rejuvenation pill and a realm-breaking pill in it as a favor for Zhang Yanxin.
Return to the palace. Lu Chen walked on the winding and rugged palace roads of the palace.
Soon he returned to Yuanxiu Hall.
